verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide or bulk data export and no migration-out path. The nearest items are adjacent: live media egress as PCM/JPEG over WebSockets, managed recording, and running signaling on your own infrastructure. None of these is a documented way to export all your data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
